 COMPLIANCE ORDER- PUBLIC OFFICE HOLDER AT THE CANADA ENERGY REGULATOR 
WHEREAS you were appointed on a part-time basis as a Director of the Canada Energy Regulator pursuant to the Canadian Energy Regulator Act and as such you are a public office holder subject to the Conflict of Interest Act (Act); 
WHEREAS section 4 of the Act sets out the circumstances under which a public office holder is generally understood to be in a conflict of interest for the purposes of the Act, namely when they exercise an official power, duty or function that provides an opportunity to further their private interests, those of their relatives or friends, or to improperly further another person's private interests; 
WHEREAS, the Canadian Energy Regulator Act imposes additional circumstances under which public office holders at the Canada Energy Regulator are understood to be in a conflict of interest for the purposes of the Act, and they include: 
(a) engaging in, as owner, shareholder, director, officer, partner or in any other way, the business of producing, selling, buying, transmitting, exporting, importing or otherwise dealing in hydrocarbons, electricity or offshore energy; 
(b) holding any bond, debenture or other security of a corporation engaged in any such business; and 
(c) holding other employment that is inconsistent with their powers, duties and functions or with any provision of this Act or a regulation made under it. 
WHEREAS the Act does not provide for the necessary measures to address the conflicts of interests for public office holders as contemplated in the Canadian Energy Regulator Act; 
WHEREAS section 30 of the Act provides the Commissioner with the additional authority to order specific measures not contemplated in the Act; 
WHEREAS the Commissioner has the authority under paragraph 51(1)(e) to make any document the Commissioner considers appropriate available for public inspection on the public registry maintained by my Office; 
AND WHEREAS, I have determined it necessary, to avoid conflicts of interests, to impose the following compliance measures on you because of your position as a Director at the Canada Energy Regulator; 
I THEREFORE ORDER YOU pursuant to section 30 of the Act to comply with the following measures: 
(a) within 60 days of your appointment file a written confidential disclosure to the Office of all of your investments and outside activities; 
(b) within 120 days of your appointment, as applicable, divest by way of sale in an arm's length transaction and/or withdraw from all of your engagements as owner, shareholder, director, officer, partner or in other ways the business of producing, selling, buying, transmitting, exporting, importing or otherwise dealing in hydrocarbons, electricity or offshore energy and to provide my Office with proof of divestment or proof of withdrawal; 
(c) within 120 days of your appointment, as applicable, divest by way of sale in an arm's length transaction of all bonds, debentures or other securities of a corporation engaged in any such business as described in paragraph (a) above and to provide my Office with proof of divestment; 
(d) within 120 days of your appointment, as applicable, withdraw from any other employment determined by the Office to be inconsistent with your power, duties and functions as a public office holder or with any provision of the Canadian Energy Regulator Act or a regulation made under it; 
(e) To file the confidential disclosures in paragraph (a) to the Office on an annual basis until the end of your mandate and to not acquire any of the investments or engage in any of the activities described in paragraphs (b), (c) and (d) above for the duration of your mandate. 
(f) Sign and return, as applicable, a statement setting out a description of each asset sold in an arm's length transaction as referred to in paragraphs (b) and (c) which will be placed on the public registry maintained by my Office.
